resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says destroyed in the 1950s; firetower.org, WillhiteWeb and Forest Lookouts say removed. The story uses removed, the wording of three of the four sources, and mentions the other.

The FFLOS record gives coordinates, but WillhiteWeb says the exact location is unknown. Metsker places the name at the north end of Red Top Mountain and the Kresek inventory places the lookout on that summit. The story reports the uncertainty rather than choosing one.

notes_for_editor: Four sources agree on the 1938 L-4 build and the 1950s removal; they disagree only on removed vs destroyed. The site location is not pinned down, so no visit or access claim is made. Staffing, fires and access today are not in any source read, so they are omitted. The brief's status, agency and registration match the sources.
